Objective: Maintain a centralized inventory of security risks.
Use a standard method to evaluate likelihood and impact.
Require formal approval for accepted risks.
Track remediation, transfer, avoidance, or acceptance.
Reassess risks on a defined schedule or after major change.
Assess vendor security posture before onboarding and renewal.
Incorporate current threats into risk decisions.
Identify missing controls against a baseline or framework.
Report remaining risk after mitigation actions.
Escalate high-risk items to leadership in a timely manner.
